records.name: Concert Operetta Theater

first_step.basis: Performances are public, and the site says reservations go through the group.

records.name: United Street Art
records.summary: A nonprofit that supports street art and graffiti culture. It runs live painting exhibitions, publishes zines and photo archives, and holds a monthly drawing meetup.
records.what_you_do: Come to the monthly Return to Sender drawing meetup, or see an exhibition where artists paint live. Artists can also work with the group on print and archive projects.

schedule.text: A drawing meetup is held monthly. The day, time and place are not listed on the page.

first_step.how: Go to the next Return to Sender drawing meetup. Check the group's site or email info@unitedstreetart.org for the next date and place.
first_step.basis: The monthly meetup is listed as an open public event, and the page names no sign up step.

records.notes: The site works but shows no dated events, so status is probably_active. Batch address 5131 W Girard Ave Unit C is not confirmed on the site, so no location was written. Social handles on the site (one for the exhibition program, one for the publishing imprint) were not recorded as URLs.

records.name: West Park Cultural Center
records.summary: An arts nonprofit in West Philadelphia that runs after school art, dance, theater and guitar classes for young people, plus summer camps and a yearly outdoor arts festival.
records.what_you_do: Sign a child up for an after school class or a summer camp. Anyone can come to the June West Park Arts Fest. Adults can volunteer, donate, or shop at the gift shop.

schedule.text: After school classes run during the school year, with a summer camp (Camp Ginkgo). The 2026 Arts Fest was on Saturday, June 13. Class times are not published on the page.

first_step.how: Pick a class on the center's program pages and use the Learn more link to enroll, or email info@westparkcultural.org for class times.
first_step.basis: Programs are open to the public, with a sign up step on the site.

records.notes: The batch URL had a typo (westparkcutural.org, which does not resolve). The working site is westparkcultural.org. A search result gave 4021 Parkside Ave as another address and a school building as the venue; the homepage address 5114 Parkside Ave is used. Camp dates, ages and class prices were not on the page, so none are recorded. Verify the address before a wide release.

records.name: Artcinia LLC
records.summary: A small arts presenter that books professional local musicians into neighborhood venues, so people can hear live concerts close to home.
records.what_you_do: Go to a concert near you from the group's concerts page, or sign up for the mailing list to hear about upcoming shows. The group also posts updates on X.

first_step.how: Sign up for the mailing list on artcinia.com, then go to a show from the concerts page.
first_step.basis: Concerts are public, and the page offers a mailing list sign up.

records.notes: The site works but has no dated events (the Next Show section has no details), so status is probably_active. Batch lists it as nonprofit, but the group is an LLC, so kind is set to program. No concert tag exists, so jam_sessions is the closest music tag. No email or phone is published.

records.name: Art-Reach Inc
records.summary: A nonprofit that connects disabled people with arts and culture. It offers a low cost admission card for museums and theaters, runs webinars and training, and advises arts groups on access.
records.what_you_do: Buy or register for an ACCESS Card to get $2 admission at partner arts sites, or join the newsletter and webinars on arts access. Arts groups can ask for accessibility training or consulting.

cost.text: ACCESS Card gives $2 admission at partner sites. Eligible people: those with a qualifying state ACCESS or EBT card, and people with disabilities who buy an Art-Reach ACCESS Card.

first_step.how: Visit art-reach.org to buy or register for an ACCESS Card, or join the newsletter for upcoming webinars.
first_step.basis: Anyone who qualifies can get the card, and the newsletter is open to sign up.

records.notes: The homepage lists no dated events, so status is probably_active. The member organization login area was not used. Batch name is Artreach Inc; the site writes Art-Reach.
